result.note: Tests the IMPACT initiative Modi proposed at the June 2026 G7 Summit and its design. The interim US deal is skipped because it was only 'nearing' completion.

questions.prompt: In June 2026, at the G7 Summit, Prime Minister Modi proposed a new initiative to finance connectivity projects in the Global South. What is this initiative called?
questions.explain: Modi proposed the International Mobilization Partnership for Accelerating Connectivity and Trade (IMPACT) at the summit. IMEC, the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor, was an existing project he cited as a model, not the new proposal.
questions.source: Modi proposed a new initiative, the International Mobilization Partnership for Accelerating Connectivity and Trade (IMPACT), combining G7 capital, Indian talent, and Global South ownership

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about Prime Minister Modi's address at the G7 Summit in June 2026:
items: The proposed IMPACT initiative would combine G7 capital, Indian talent and Global South ownership.
IMPACT is meant to finance connectivity projects across Africa, Latin America and the Pacific island countries.
Modi highlighted the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) as a model for strengthening supply chains.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: All three statements match the story. Modi positioned India as a bridge between developed and developing economies, and TBB notes that IMPACT scales up the IMEC bet, which had stalled when war broke out along its route.
questions.source: to finance connectivity projects across Africa, Latin America, and the Pacific island countries.
